title: Long NVDA — Annual Meeting Conditional Add (June 24 Jensen + DXY Gate)
entry: Enter $205–215 conditional on EITHER (1) DXY US session close below 100.00 on June 22 (macro gate cleared — NVDA conditional add unlocked for all three gate conditions), OR (2) Jensen Huang at the NVDA Annual Meeting June 24, 9 AM PT virtual, explicitly addresses AI demand as strong/accelerating ('demand is extraordinary,' '$200B+ infrastructure year confirmed,' 'Taiwan $150B procurement on track'). Both conditions are gate-clearing events. Do NOT add on an intraday DXY dip — only the 4 PM ET US session close counts for condition (1). If neither condition triggers by June 24 close, this opportunity remains open but un-entered; re-assess after MU earnings print and PCE June 25.
stop_loss: $195 daily close — below the June 10 re-entry zone floor and the primary HOLD-regime support level; implies a macro regime shift to STEP_ASIDE (DXY > 101 or SPX < 7,460 on a daily close) that removes the framework supporting NVDA longs
targets: $232 — prior May resistance and the post-DXY-gate first price objective; DXY below 99.00 confirms macro tailwind; +10.4% from $210.10 entry; take 40% of position
$248 — May all-time high retest; MU earnings beat validates AI hardware demand and lifts the entire semis complex; NVDA recovers full pre-DXY-correction valuation; +18.1%; take 40%
$272 — blue sky: Jensen Annual Meeting confirms Taiwan $150B delivery on 2026 timeline AND H2 NDA pipeline above $100B; sell-side upgrades raise consensus target to $285; +29.5%; hold remaining 20%
catalyst: NVIDIA Annual Meeting of Stockholders is June 24, 2026 at 9 AM PT (virtual). Agenda items include Jensen's AI demand commentary, Taiwan $150B government-partnership spending timeline, H2 2026 NDA product roadmap, and the rationale for the $25B debt offering (largest-ever tech bond deal). This is the strongest single-name catalyst in the AI hardware complex before July earnings season. The DXY gate condition (US session close below 100.00) operates independently — as of June 22 morning DXY is at 100.80 in Asian session (recovered from 100.23 weekend low), meaning the gate is 80bps from clearing. The Annual Meeting override operates regardless of DXY: strong Jensen commentary unlocks the add even if DXY does not close below 100 on June 22. MU Q3 earnings after close on the same day (June 24) provide an additional AI semis readthrough that amplifies or dampens NVDA's Annual Meeting signal.
thesis:
NVDA's Annual Meeting creates a defined catalyst window that is distinct from the general DXY-gated HOLD framework. The existing NVDA position (long-nvda-apple-google-siri-reentry-2026-06-10) holds at $207-210 with stop $195, established on the Apple/Siri/Google partnership catalyst. This additional layer targets the specific AI-demand-at-scale narrative that Jensen will address on June 24 — a fundamentally different catalyst that operates even if the Siri partnership thesis remains incomplete. The two opportunities are complementary, not duplicative: they represent two distinct reasons to own NVDA at the same price level.

The DXY gate at 100.00 is the primary macro constraint on adding NVDA risk in the HOLD regime. The hawkish FOMC (Warsh dot plot: nine hike projections, 3.8% 2026 median, 60.7% October hike probability) and Iran-Hezbollah headline risk have kept DXY bid above 100. A DXY close below 100 would signal that the oil-disinflation impulse from the Iran 60-day roadmap is beginning to transmit into FX — reducing the rate-premium embedded in the dollar and removing the single largest macro headwind for high-multiple AI longs. NVDA at 21.5× forward P/E is highly sensitive to the discount rate embedded in the DXY: a 100bps DXY decline typically corresponds to a 3-5% re-rating in NVDA's forward multiple.

Jensen's June 24 Annual Meeting commentary matters because NVDA has not provided forward guidance since the Q1 earnings call. In the intervening period, the $25B debt offering generated $85B in orders — 3.4× oversubscribed — confirming institutional demand for NVDA credit exposure. The Annual Meeting is where Jensen can qualitatively address whether Q2 NDA demand ($91B+ consensus revenue) is tracking ahead or in-line, whether the Taiwan $150B partnership is on schedule, and whether any supply constraints have eased ahead of Blackwell production ramp. A constructive read from Jensen lifts the entire AI hardware complex and accelerates the add-signal for existing holders.

The counter-party argues: (1) NVDA at $210 is 21.5× forward earnings on a product cycle that has already delivered its primary beat (Blackwell launch), meaning further upside requires confirming the NEXT cycle ahead of schedule; (2) China export restrictions (H20 chip ban maintained) permanently impairs a $5-8B annual revenue line that cannot be recovered without policy change; (3) AMD's MI350 roadmap confirms that NVDA's datacenter GPU monopoly is 18-24 months from a serious competitive challenge. The 3% position size and $195 stop limit total capital at risk to approximately 7.1% of the 3% allocation — 0.21% of total portfolio — appropriate for a conditional entry that has not yet been triggered.
bull_case: DXY closes at 99.60 on June 22 US session (gate cleared). NVDA conditional add executes at $208 on June 23 open. Jensen June 24 Annual Meeting: 'Q2 NDA demand is tracking toward $93B — 2% above consensus. Taiwan manufacturing partnership is on track to deliver $150B in US commitments by December. Demand for Blackwell GB200 NVL72 through H2 2026 remains extraordinary.' MU beats after the same session. NVDA to $232 by June 27; $248 by July 10 ahead of Q2 earnings; $272 blue-sky territory by late July on Q2 beat-and-raise.
bear_case: DXY closes at 100.70 on June 22 (gate not cleared). Jensen June 24 Annual Meeting notes 'we continue to see strong demand but are monitoring inventory levels at certain cloud customers' — interpreted as a subtle softening signal. MU earnings guide disappoints. NVDA falls from $210 to $202-205 on the day; stop at $195 not triggered. Conditional add does not execute. Position held as open with no new entry. Opportunity remains 'active' but un-entered until a subsequent gate-clearing event.
invalidation: $195 daily close; OR DXY closes above 101.00 on June 22 AND SPX gaps below 7,460 (regime shifts to STEP_ASIDE — exit full NVDA exposure, not just suspend add); OR Jensen Annual Meeting contains explicit demand-softening language about cloud customer digestion; OR PCE prints at or above 4.3% YoY on June 25 (30Y forced through 5.00% before NVDA can recover); OR China announces additional export restriction escalation that expands beyond H20 to the H100 product family

outcome.outcome_label: Stop triggered — NVDA June 26 close $192.53 < $195 stop
outcome.note: NVDA closed at $192.53 on June 26, breaching the $195 daily-close stop. Stop Day 2 (June 29) pre-market at $195.15, but June 26 close already triggered the stop. Stop Day cascade driven by KOSPI -5.81% sell-on-Samsung Blue House blueprint and $165B quarter-end institutional selling. DXY never cleared the 99.00 gate. Full exit at $192.53 vs $210.10 entry midpoint.
